title: Syntheses, structure and single-molecule magnet behavior of a rhombus shaped Dy4 cluster

material_class.structural_family: rhombus-shaped tetranuclear Dy4 cluster with distorted square-antiprismatic Dy(III) coordination

synthesis.procedure: A solution of Dy(acac)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) in 25 mL of CH3CN was heated to 70 °C, then a CH2Cl2 solution (3 mL) containing HL (0.025 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred for 3 h at 70 °C and cooled to room temperature. After filtration, the solution was concentrated by slow evaporation at room temperature. After about 5 days, block-shaped yellow crystals of 1 were obtained.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration, then slow evaporation at room temperature to give block-shaped yellow crystals

properties.summary: Cluster 1 is a Dy4 SMM showing two magnetic relaxation processes under zero dc field (LT: ΔE/kB = 37.73 K, τ0 = 8.19×10−7 s; HT: ΔE/kB = 105.97 K, τ0 = 4.36×10−8 s). χMT at 300 K is close to four isolated Dy(III) ions and decreases to 19.50 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, consistent with Stark-level depopulation and/or weak antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. Magnetization at 2.0 K does not saturate (16.10 Nβ at 80 kOe). Frequency- and temperature-dependent ac susceptibility, Cole–Cole α = 0.18–0.50 (2.0–14.0 K), and QTM near 2 K that is largely suppressed under 500 Oe dc field were reported.
